title: THE COUNTERWEIGHT
briefing: A cable crane hangs over the spillway. LOWER pays out one notch of cable and racks one counterweight block; HOIST reels in a notch and drops a block. The hoist interlock only reads the counterweight: with no blocks racked it refuses. If the cable ever reads below zero, the drum winds past its stop and the cable snaps.
